Class Student

public class Student extends Object

      public Student(String flavour, SnackMachine snackMachine)
      Constructs a new Student with a specified favourite flavour.

      flavour - the student's favourite flavour (the crisps they will buy).
      snackMachine - a reference to a snackMachine object to buy crisps from.

  • Method Details

    • snackTime

      public void snackTime()
      Completes an action based on what the student currently has. Buys a pack if the student doesn't have one yet. Opens a packet the student has one already that is closed. If the student has an open packet already, it eats a crisp. If the student's packet is empty, it is discarded.
